 These viral favorites are no strangers to selling out. By Christa Joanna Lee November 17, 2026 Collage: Jemeria Davison; Source images: Courtesy of brands Save Story Save this story Save Story Save this story [LAST UPDATED AT 1:40 P.M. ET ON NOVEMBER 17, 2026] Shopping is a lot more fun when you're not fighting off a turkey coma, which is why we're getting a head start on the best early K-beauty Black Friday deals. You don't have to wait until Thanksgiving to score major savings on the Korean skin-care , makeup , and hair-care products that have taken over our routines. From glow-boosting serums to cushion foundations and scalp-soothing shampoos, some of our favorite K-beauty brands are already slashing prices. You might as well fill your cart before you fill your plate, whether you're restocking your holy grails, finally trying that viral product you've had bookmarked for months, or getting a jump on holiday gifting .
 Our Top Early K-Beauty Black Friday Deals 
 A Shot at Smoother Skin: Celimax Vita-A Retinal Shot Tightening Booster, $24 $18 
 A Little Lift-Me-Up: Anua Collagen Retinol Refining Gua Sha Cream , $35 $29 
 Cover All Your Bases: TirTir Mask Fit Red Cushion Foundation , $25 $19 
 A Groot Awakening: Dr. Groot Thickening Shampoo & Conditioner Set , $66 $53 
 Celimax Vita-A Retinal Shot Tightening Booster Save to wishlist Save to wishlist Celimax
 Vita-A Retinal Shot Tightening Booster
 $24 $18 (25% off) Amazon
 Allure commerce editor Sarah Han applying
 Sarah Han K-beauty has a knack for making potent ingredients feel a little less intimidating, and Celimax’s The Vita A Retinal Shot Tightening Booster is a good example. Designed for seasoned retinoid users looking to step things up, it features 0.1% retinal —a faster-acting vitamin A derivative that's just one conversion step away from retinoic acid (meaning it’s potent, even more so than retinol). It also contains hydrolyzed sponge “spicules,” which help ingredients penetrate more effectively to address fine lines, rough texture, and enlarged pores. “As someone who doesn't partake in Botox and the like, this is my main line of defense against signs of aging—especially on my forehead, where I tend to target the product,” says commerce editor Sarah Han .
 Anua Collagen Retinol Refining Gua Sha Cream Allure contributing commerce writer Christa Joanna Lee applying the Anua Collagen Retinol Refining Gua Sha Cream
 Christa Joanna Lee Save to wishlist Save to wishlist Anua
 Collagen Retinol Refining Gua Sha Cream
 $35 $28 (20% off) Amazon
 Sooo, this is kind of genius? Part face cream , part sculpting tool , Anua’s Collagen Retinol Refining Gua Sha Cream combines retinol with nourishing moisturizers like squalane, panthenol, and collagen to smooth fine lines without skimping on hydration. But the real selling point is the built-in, W-shaped metal applicator, which hugs the contours of your face and neck while delivering a cooling, depuffing massage (though you can always apply it with your fingers when you're short on time).
 Ma:nyo Pure Cleansing Oil Save to wishlist Save to wishlist Manyo
 Pure Cleansing Oil
 $23 $17 (26% off) Amazon
 Lee applying the Manyo Pure Cleansing Oil
 Christa Joanna Lee K-beauty brands seem determined to make removing a full face of makeup easier than putting it on, and we're not complaining. Ma:nyo’s Pure Cleansing Oil, a 2025 Best of Beauty Award winner, makes a pretty strong case for itself with 14 plant-derived ingredients, including argan, jojoba, olive, and grapeseed oils, that dissolve makeup, sunscreen, and excess sebum without stripping skin of moisture. The lightweight formula turns milky when mixed with water and rinses away without leaving a greasy film. “Manyo's Pure Cleansing Oil cuts through everything—and I mean everything ,” says Lee. “Stubborn waterproof eyeliner be damned!”
 Round Lab Birch Juice Moisturizing UV LOCK SPF 50 Lee applying the Round Lab Birch Juice Moisturizing UV LOCK SPF 50
 Christa Joanna Lee Save to wishlist Save to wishlist Round Lab
 Birch Juice Moisturizing UV LOCK SPF 50
 $28 $22 (21% off) Amazon
 One swipe of Round Lab Birch Moisturizing Sunscreen UVLock SPF 45+ and you'll understand why Lee is already on her fourth bottle of this viral K-beauty favorite . The lightweight sunscreen combines hyaluronic acid and glycerin for hydration with birch sap, panthenol, and purslane extract to help soothe skin and keep it comfortable throughout the day. “I don’t think I’ve met a sunscreen that has disappeared this quickly and feels so smooth going on my dry, sensitive skin,” says Lee.
 Save to wishlist Save to wishlist Centellian 24
 Madeca Cream Time Reverse
 $32 $20 (38% off) Amazon
 With more than 100 million Madeca Creams sold, it's safe to say Centellian24 doesn't need much of an introduction. But if you're just getting acquainted with the K-beauty favorite, its Madeca Cream Time Reverse is a good place to start, pairing our good friend retinol with madecassoside, a soothing compound derived from Centella asiatica (a.k.a. cica ), plus barrier-supporting ceramides and multiple forms of hyaluronic acid to keep skin plump and hydrated. Resveratrol and sodium DNA add antioxidant and skin-conditioning benefits, all in an airy, lightweight cream.
 Save to wishlist Save to wishlist Tirtir
 Mask Fit Red Cushion Foundation
 $25 $19 (24% off) Amazon
 Finding your shade in a K-beauty cushion foundation used to be easier said than done, but TirTir's Mask Fit Red Cushion is helping change that with an impressive 40-shade lineup. The medium-to-full-coverage formula also packs brightening niacinamide , hydrating glycerin, and antioxidant-rich flower extracts into a base that looks and feels like skin. “Even better, it doesn't settle into the creases around my nose or the fine lines under my eyes, yet still delivers enough coverage to blur my melasma and even out my skin tone,” says Lee.
 Save to wishlist Save to wishlist Banila Co
 Clean It Zero Original Cleansing Balm
 $29 $20 (31% off) Amazon
 Banila Co has expanded its Clean It Zero lineup to tackle different skin concerns, but in our opinion, you just can't beat the Original. The sherbet-like balm transforms into a silky oil that melts away even stubborn makeup, leaving nothing behind to fail the white-towel test. “It has such a soft, milky texture that leaves skin smoother and more hydrated,” Claire Chang , MD, a board-certified dermatologist based in New York City, previously told Allure . Bamboo extract soothes skin, while antioxidant-rich acerola cherry extract and vitamin E provide extra protection against environmental stressors that can contribute to premature signs of aging.
 Save to wishlist Save to wishlist Cosrx
 Peptide Collagen Serum Toner
 $25 $18 (28% off) Amazon
 Why settle for one peptide when you can have six? CosRx’s Peptide Collagen Serum Toner packs that many peptides into a single lightweight formula to help tackle fine lines, loss of firmness, uneven texture, and enlarged pores, potentially saving you from having to layer multiple serums (and one that Allure commerce editor Sarah Han likes to use in place of toner ). Niacinamide adds brightening benefits, while glycerin and hyaluronic acid deliver a boost of hydration—all in a watery, fast-absorbing texture that won't leave skin feeling sticky.
 Save to wishlist Save to wishlist Abib
 PDRN Volume Fill-it Booster Cream 2.5
 $28 $20 (29% off) Amazon
 We know, we know—we're surprised it took us this long to bring up PDRN , too. The buzzy K-beauty ingredient, short for polydeoxyribonucleotide, consists of DNA fragments typically derived from salmon, and getting it via injections is touted for its skin-repairing and firming benefits (though research on what it can do in topical skin care is still limited). Abib's PDRN Volume Fill-it Booster Cream 2.5 pairs it with Volufiline, an ingredient marketed for its plumping effects, plus hydrating glycerin, barrier-supporting ceramides, and retinal to help soften the look of fine lines and give skin a smoother, bouncier appearance.
 Save to wishlist Save to wishlist Mixsoon
 Bean Essence
 $37 $22 (41% off) Amazon
 Mixsoon’s Bean Essence is a K-beauty favorite packed with fermented soybeans to gently exfoliate, smooth texture, and leave skin looking fresh, bouncy, and glowing—which is why it’s become popular among Korean makeup artists to prep the complexion before makeup application. “If you’d rather skip the snail mucin, this Mixsoon essence provides an equally satisfying gooey-but-not-sticky formula that transforms my dull, dry skin into a glowing, plump dream,” says Han.
 Save to wishlist Save to wishlist Colorgram
 Nude Blur Tint Trio Kit
 $37 $28 (24% off) Amazon
 A neutral lip shade means something different for everyone, and Colorgram's Nude Blur Tint Lip Trio Kit makes a personal color easier to create with two complementary nude tints and a coordinating lip pencil, so you can experiment with different tones and finishes. Or, wear each shade on its own to suit your look.
 Save to wishlist Save to wishlist Dr. Groot
 Thickening Shampoo & Conditioner Set
 $66 $53 (20% off) Amazon
 No, Dr. Groot isn't an actual doctor, but the Korean hair-care brand has made scalp health and thinning hair its specialty—with the science to back it up. The Best of-Beauty winning Thickening Shampoo & Conditioner Set combines biotin, rosemary, caffeine, and prebiotics to help keep the scalp balanced, strengthen strands, and minimize breakage. The duo also washes away excess oil and buildup without stripping moisture, leaving hair feeling softer, healthier, and more voluminous.

 How We Find the Best Korean Beauty Deals 
 Our shopping team searches daily for the best beauty products in the industry. We enlist the help of multiple editors, writers, contributors, and experts to determine which products are really worth your penny. Our Black Friday 2026 beauty sales are no different: We base our discounted selections on products with at least 4.0-star average ratings, past Allure Best of Beauty award winners, and those that our editors and experts have tried and given a stamp of approval.
 Why Trust Allure for the Best Korean Beauty Deals? 
 No matter what you seek or your individual needs and concerns when you’re shopping for the best Black Friday 2026 K-beauty deals, w e want to ensure that you love anything we recommend in our stories. We believe that having a diverse team of writers and editors—in addition to the wide range of outside testers and industry experts we regularly call upon—is essential to reaching that goal.
